item.title: Version 7.0.4b5
item.description: Improves timeline scrolling with cached title formatting and cell layouts, in-place row updates, and background thumbnail decoding. News uses smaller decoded thumbnails; Blog skips thumbnail loading. Universal app, Developer ID signed, notarized, and stapled.

item.title: Version 7.0.4b5
item.description: Fixes clipped text and jumpy scrolling in Social timelines by measuring the exact cell width, caching row heights, and updating heights only when content, appearance, or width changes. Developer ID signed, notarized, and stapled.

item.title: Version 7.0.4b5
item.description: Ports the Social, News, and Blog timeline layouts to macOS with stable high-resolution thumbnails, compact News favicons, circular Social avatars, clearer text, and reliable style refreshes.

item.title: Version 7.0.4b5
item.description: First Frontpage macOS release of Tsugi 7.0.4b5, universal for Apple Silicon and Intel.
